label: Relative error at a grid point
section: Relative error at a grid point
subgoals: Divide the absolute difference by the golden value
Express the result as a percentage
Apply the check to every table type, not only delay

label: Maximum error over a table
subgoals: Compute the relative error at every grid point of the table
Take the maximum, not the mean, as the table's score
Report where the worst entry sits to localize the cause

label: Tolerances with an absolute floor
subgoals: Allow each entry the larger of a relative and an absolute tolerance
Count the entries that exceed their own tolerance
Version the tolerance so loosening it is itself a reviewed change
